This position requires a highly collaborative leader capable of coordinating cross-functional teams, driving operational rigor, and ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational standards. Infrastructure Deployment & Capacity Expansion Oversee server rack deployments, hardware installations, and capacity expansion projects.
